latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Video Editor Offline — local, cloud-powered video editing with no cloud uploads required.

- Instantly edit and export video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV up to 500MB) using AI, all processed via secure cloud GPUs.
- No installation or steep learning curve: just upload your footage and describe your edits (e.g., "trim silences, add transitions").
- No cloud uploads or subscriptions required; files remain local until export is ready for download.
- Handles common workflows: trimming, transitions, text overlays, audio tracks, and batch processing.
- Automatic token management and session handling; supports anonymous and registered users.
- Full support for exporting high-quality MP4 videos, with clear error handling and workflow guidance.
